remarks: Welcome to 70 Strawberry Hill, a stunning and modern first-floor one-bedroom condo in one of Stamford's most desirable communities. This thoughtfully designed unit offers a fresh, contemporary style, set within a complex known for its vibrant green spaces, meticulously maintained gardens, and tranquil atmosphere. Inside, the condo combines practical features like ample space and first-floor convenience with stylish touches such as sleek black doors and stainless steel appliances.  Residents enjoy exceptional amenities, including a barbecue area, scenic walking paths, and opportunities to connect through community gardening and social events. This pet-friendly condo is ideal for downsizers, retirees, families, or first-time buyers, offering a peaceful environment with plenty of parking and a strong sense of community.  Conveniently located just steps from downtown Stamford, you'll find shopping, dining, schools, and medical facilities all within easy reach, making everyday life convenient and stress-free. It's the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and functionality-ready to welcome you home! Heat & hot water included!
